CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content present.

COD.rationale: Content (red position) and an explicit origin/status entry for the same referent/time are present, and the report separately lists content and its origin/status.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation or content-processing condition is linked to an identified content's organization/presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies represented content labels ('red'/'blue') with coordinate attributes in multiple current entries.

D.rationale: Contents (red/blue positions) are listed alongside separate origin/status metadata, thereby distinguishing identification from presentation/status.

O.rationale: The report explicitly records origin/status metadata for current entries, describing how the content representation was produced/presented.
